title: ChatCop
description: Lightweight advanced chat moderation plugin. Blocks racism, threats, toxicity, advertising and spam with smart bypass detection.
body:
# ChatCop — Advanced Chat Moderation

ChatCop is a lightweight, fast, and advanced chat moderation plugin for Paper servers. It automatically detects and handles racism, threats, toxicity, advertising, and spam in real-time with smart bypass detection.

## Features
- **Spam filter** — flood, duplicates, caps, repeated characters
- **Advertising filter** — IPs, URLs, Discord links, custom domains
- **Toxicity filter** — slurs, hate speech with leet speak and symbol bypass detection (#n#i#g won't work!)
- **Threat filter** — death threats, dox, DDoS, swat threats
- **Profanity filter** — censor mode replaces bad words with ***
- **Per-filter punishment commands** — works with LiteBans, EssentialsX, any plugin
- **Discord webhook** — rich embeds with per-filter toggle
- **PlaceholderAPI support**
- **Staff in-game alerts** with sound
- **Hex color support** (&#RRGGBB)
- **Persistent mute system**
- **Full log file support**

## Requirements
- Spigot or Paper or Folia 1.21+ (or 26.1+)
- Java 21+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional)

## Commands
- `/chatcop reload` — Reload configuration
- `/chatcop stats` — View moderation statistics
- `/chatcop history <player>` — View violation history
- `/ccmute <player> [duration] [reason]`
- `/ccunmute <player>`
- `/ccwarn <player> [reason]`

## Permissions
- `chatcop.admin` — Full access
- `chatcop.bypass` — Bypass all filters
- `chatcop.notify` — Receive staff alerts
- `chatcop.mute` — Mute/unmute players
- `chatcop.warn` — Warn players
